title: Page 9
content_zh:
但这样的接触还不够。
于季友打横抱起娇妻，放上簇新艳红的床褥。他迫不及待扯开云肩扣绊、乃至底下霞帔绑带……每个动作虽快，手劲却依旧细致温柔，只是解到了里衣，他眼神有些急了。
他头次发现，女人家得穿上这么多衣裳。
“坐好。”普宁笑着推开他。
于季友坐定，盯着她微开的上襟动了下嘴巴。
他好像说了什么，但普宁没听清楚，而他表情，似乎也老早忘记了。普宁解开自己衣裳，当薄软的里衣滑下，露出绣上华艳牡丹的抹胸时，他色神热的，仿佛要将她烧融了般。
“帮我解袜。”她朝床一倚，锦袜的小脚儿一伸，媚眼如丝。
他解开缚绑的丝带，一只宛如藉般可爱的脚掌露出。公主娇贵，就连脚踝脚跟这些粗糙处，也无比滑嫩、香馥。
他像捧持宝物般凑到嘴边，一根一根，一寸一寸舔吻过。
普宁娇喘如吟。
“你好甜、好美……”温泉水滑洗凝脂－－他脑子里浮现她传来的诗句。读信时他就在想，不知她那身吹弹可破的雪肌抚起来的感受，会是怎般的销魂滋味。
这会儿，他可是全懂了。
也难怪白居易会吟“从此君王不早朝”，抚了她这身细若凝脂的股肤，他再也不想挪开手了。
只是，他突然想到，明一早天亮，定会有许多亲朋好友登门拜访－－说不准整个白天，会全浪费在那些宾客身上。这怎么行！他眉头皱紧。他娶新娘是为了朝夕相处，可不是为了让那些人一窥公主面貌的。
很快地，一个念头闪过他脑袋。
“苹儿，”他低唤她的闺名。“想不想跟我做件大胆的事？”
她张开氤氲的大眼。“只要你不会半途遗下我。”
“当然不会。这事没你一块，还有什么趣味？”
他跳下床，从木箱子里拾了几件衣裳，帮自个儿跟她穿好衣服后，再取了两件斗篷，一件他穿，一件披在她身上。
然后磨墨写了张字条，拿重物一压，包袱一拎娇妻一抱，两人就这么晃悠悠地离开于府大宅。

字条上写－－
带普宁骑马去玩，几天回来，勿挂念。
他知道明一早他爹看见字条，一定会生气，回来免不了捱几顿念。不过，那都是回来以后的事了。
他的爱驹就关在马房。他左右探探，确定无人过来，才要普宁在门边稍待。
白驹看见主人相当开心，鼻头直喷气。于季友挲着他鼻子要它安静，然后开栏栅放它出来。
才刚听到蹄声，白马已来到身后。
普宁回头，看见他朝她伸手，她毫不犹豫地握住，被他抱上了马背。
他大腿一夹，马儿如箭般驰了出去。
“真开心见到你。”普宁挲挲白驹光滑的马颈。
像听得懂她说话似的，直视的马头晃了一晃。
她惊讶地回头问：“它在回应我？”
“是啊，它记得你了。”他笑着搂紧她腰。
白驹流畅地跑着，两人一马只在城门前稍停了下，于季友拿出通行腰牌。
城门守官认牌不认人，一见，立刻开门放行。
“我们要上哪？”她看着飞逝的景色问道。
“大漠。”他亲亲她，这会儿旁无他人，他一下抛去了向来恪守的礼节。“在翠岭村不是答应过你，等我们成了亲，我会带你四处游历。”
“太棒了。”她回头嚷道。
他忙按住她嘴，她俏皮吐舌。
“太开心，忘了夜里声音会传很远。”
他笑。“过了这城，人烟就少了，那时你要怎么喊声都行。”

“距离远么？”
“挺远。”他空出手帮她把斗篷帽子带上。“不过不赶路，再骑一阵我们找家客栈住下，白天还可上街市晃荡，等吃饱喝足玩倦了，再上马前行。”
“我们就这样跑出来，万一公婆生气？”
他笑拧她的鼻。“承蒙你庇荫，我现在可是堂堂驸马，谁敢说我不是？”
觉坏了他。她一瞪，可是眉宇毫无怒意。“虽说公公婆婆不至于降罪，但隔个两天我们还是得盥讯回去，让他们安心。
“遵命，我的好贤妻。”
话说完，他再次扯紧马缰，催马快跑。
第10章(2)
当晚深夜，两人留宿客栈，这对普宁来说，又是个惊奇。
“原来客栈长这模样－－”她在房里绕着圈圈。“我以前一直央李进带我进来看看，可他说客栈里龙蛇混杂，不安全。”
于季友要小二送来热水，这会儿正拧着巾子要普宁擦擦头脸。
“累不累？”
她看着他摇头。“你呢？”
“我也不累。”他将她抱上膝头，开始亲吻她嘴。“说来委屈了你，新婚头夜，睡的却是客栈的硬床。”
“有什么好委屈，你忘了，更糟的地方我都睡过。”她一脸不在意。
“我怎么可能忘得了－－”他再次解开她衣裳。“还记得头回跟你同床共枕，你都睡熟了，我却睁眼直到天明。”
这事儿她当真不晓得。“你为什么不睡？”
“因为我一双眼老瞅着你的嘴。”他没说，其实当时他不只看，还偷偷亲了好几回。
他抱她上床，身子跟着贴紧她。
普宁再一次晕厥，这一次，于季友没再吵醒她。

她需要休息。
他抚着她汗湿的颊爱怜地看着她，他喜欢看她睡在自己身边的模样，而他也知道，今后除了死亡之外，再也没人能把她带离他身边。
她是他的妻，他人生的依靠。
“好好睡，我的小苹儿。”怜爱至极地一吻后，他拉来薄被，两人密密盖上。
新婚第一天，普宁睡到日上三竿，才被食物香味诱醒。
眼未睁，她肚子率先发出饿呜。
“看来，我昨天真的是累坏你了。”于季友低笑。
她红着脸坐起身。“别一大早就这么轻佻！”
“谁说早。”他开窗，让她瞧瞧外头天色。
她眼眨巴眨巴，一下说不出话来。
他笑着将他买的吃食送上。刚才她还睡着，他在窗边看见有人卖藕丸子，想着让她尝鲜，遂下楼买了些上来。
进门，她就醒来了。
“小心烫。”
她挟了一个炸得金黄的藕丸子，一咬，那酥脆的皮还有里边绵软的藕浆化在舌上，清香四溢，是她从未尝过的新鲜好滋味。
“好吃么？”他微笑问。
她连连点头。“你也试一个。”
她挟起一个喂他，开头他还害差不肯吃，但看见她央求的脸，他还是乖乖张了口。
他嘴大，一嘴就是一个。
她喜孜孜地算了算。“还有六个，我们一人分三个。”
他揉揉她发。“剩下给你，我一早去喂马已先吃了两个馒头。等会儿穿好衣裳，我带你下楼逛逛。”

须臾，两人一道出了客栈。普宁一路前后张望，对她来说，寻常人家常见的画面，全是身为公主的她难以一窥的惊奇，难怪她会这么干心。
他带她出游的目的，除了满足她的好奇心之外，也是为了帮她添些较不引人注目的衣裳。
她自宫里带出来的嫁裳，件件不是用料精致，绣工细腻。这些衣裳穿在城镇里走动还没什么问题，可一出关口，感觉就突兀了。
在布庄，于季友这些那些选了几件对襟长袍，又多买了件镶滚着银鼠毛的大斗篷－－备着以防得露宿野林，还买齐了腊肉，跟烤得硬脆的面饼。回到客栈，付了房钱两人便骑马上路。
从襄州到大漠，少也要十多日时间，两人就这样偶尔落脚客栈，偶尔卷着斗篷睡在野林。有城镇投宿就吃得好些，没有，于季友也能靠买来的弩弓射些飞禽走兽煮食－－总之衣食无虞。
content_en:
But such contact is not enough.
Yu Jiyou picked up his beloved wife and placed her on a brand new bright red mattress. He couldn't wait to pull off the Yun shoulder buckle and even the Xiapei straps underneath... Although every movement was fast, his hands were still delicate and gentle. But when he untied his inner clothes, his eyes became a little anxious.
It was the first time he discovered that women had to wear so many clothes.
"Sit tight." Puning smiled and pushed him away.
Yu Jiyou sat down, stared at her slightly opened upper lapel, and moved his mouth.
He seemed to have said something, but Puning didn't hear it clearly, and his expression seemed to have been forgotten long ago. Puning unbuttoned his clothes, and when the soft inner shirt slid down to reveal the tube top embroidered with gorgeous peonies, his expression was so hot that he seemed to melt her.
"Help me untie my socks." She leaned towards the bed, stretched out her little feet in brocade socks, and looked as charming as silk.
He untied the ribbon, revealing a lovely borrowed foot. The princess is delicate, even the rough areas like ankles and heels are extremely smooth and fragrant.
He brought it to his mouth like a treasure, licking and kissing them inch by inch.
Puning gasped like a moan.
"You are so sweet and beautiful..." The hot spring water washes away the fat - the poem she sent came to his mind. As he was reading the letter, he was thinking about how ecstatic it would be to feel her soft and fragile snow-covered skin.
At this moment, he understood everything.
It's no wonder that Bai Juyi would chant "From now on, the king will never come to court early" and caressed her butt skin, which was as thin as gelatin, and he never wanted to move his hand away.
However, it suddenly occurred to him that at dawn tomorrow morning, many relatives and friends would come to visit him - maybe the entire day would be wasted on those guests. How can this work! He frowned. He married his bride to get along day and night, not to let those people get a glimpse of the princess.
Soon, an idea flashed through his head.
"Ping'er," he whispered her given name. "Want to do something bold with me?"
She opened her big eyes. "As long as you don't leave me halfway."
"Of course not. Without you, what's the fun?"
He jumped out of bed and picked up a few clothes from the wooden box. After helping himself and her get dressed, he took out two cloaks, one for him to wear and one to put on her.
Then he wrote a note with ink, pressed it down with a heavy object, picked up the baggage and hugged his beloved wife, and the two of them left the Yu Mansion in a leisurely manner.
The note says--
Take Puning to ride a horse and play. Don’t miss her when you come back in a few days.
He knew that his father would be angry when he saw the note tomorrow morning, and he would inevitably be read several times when he came back. However, that will all happen after returning.
His beloved horse is kept in the stable. He looked around to make sure no one was coming, and then asked Puning to wait by the door.
Bai Ju was very happy to see his master and snorted straight from his nose. Yu Jiyou rubbed his nose to make it quiet, then opened the fence and let it out.
Just when I heard the sound of hoofbeats, the white horse was already behind me.
Puning turned around and saw him reaching out to her. She took it without hesitation and was carried on the horse by him.
He clamped his thighs together, and the horse galloped away like an arrow.
"I'm so happy to see you." Puning stroked the white horse's smooth neck.
As if he understood what she was saying, the horse's head that was looking straight at him shook.
She turned back in surprise and asked, "Is it responding to me?"
"Yes, it remembers you." He smiled and hugged her waist tightly.
Bai Ju ran smoothly, and the two men and one horse stopped briefly in front of the city gate, and Yu Jiyou took out his pass badge.
The city gate guard recognized the sign but not the person. When he saw it, he immediately opened the door to let people go.
"Where are we going?" she asked, looking at the passing scenery.
"Desert." He kissed her. There was no one else around at the moment, and he threw away the etiquette he had always adhered to. "I promised you in Cuiling Village that when we get married, I will take you to travel around."
"That's great," she shouted over her shoulder.
He quickly pressed her mouth and she stuck out her tongue playfully.
"I was so happy that I forgot that sounds can travel far at night."
He laughs. "After passing this city, there will be fewer people, and you can shout as much as you want. "
"Is it far? "
"Quite far. He used his free hand to help her put on her cloak and hat. "But we are not in a hurry. We will find an inn to stay at after riding for a while. We can also wander around the market during the day. When we are tired of eating, drinking, and playing, we can get on the horse and move on." "
"What if our parents-in-law are angry if we run out like this? "
He smiled and pinched her nose. "Thanks to your protection, I am now a royal consort, who dares to say that I am not? "
He felt bad. She glared, but there was no anger in her eyebrows. "Although the parents-in-law will not be punished, we still have to go back after two days to reassure them.
"As you command, my good wife."
After saying this, he tightened the reins of the horse again and urged the horse to run faster.
Chapter 10(2)
Late that night, the two stayed at the inn, which was another surprise for Puning.
"So the innkeeper looks like this -" She circled around the room. "I used to ask Li Jin to take me in to take a look, but he said that it was unsafe because there was a mixture of dragons and snakes in the inn."
Yu Jiyou asked the waiter to bring hot water, and was now twisting a towel to ask Puning to wipe his head and face.
"Are you tired?"
She looked at him and shook his head. "What about you?"
"I'm not tired either." He held her on his lap and began to kiss her mouth. "I feel sorry for you. On the first night of your wedding, you slept on a hard bed in an inn."
"What's wrong with you? You forgot. I've slept in worse places." She looked unconcerned.
"How could I forget--" He unbuttoned her clothes again. "I still remember the first time I slept in the same bed with you. You were fast asleep, but I kept my eyes open until dawn."
She really didn't know about this. "Why don't you sleep?"
"Because I always look at your mouth." He didn't say it. In fact, he not only looked at it, but also secretly kissed it several times.
He carried her to bed and pressed his body against hers.
Puning fainted again. This time, Yu Jiyou did not wake her up.
She needs rest.
He caressed her sweaty cheek and looked at her lovingly. He liked to see her sleeping next to him, and he also knew that no one could take her away from him except death.
She is his wife and his support in life.
"Sleep well, my little Ping'er." After a loving kiss, he pulled the thin quilt over and covered the two of them closely.
On the first day of their wedding, Puning slept until three o'clock in the morning before being awakened by the smell of food.
Before she opened her eyes, her stomach was the first to let out a hungry growl.
"It seems that I really exhausted you yesterday." Yu Jiyou chuckled.
She sat up with a blush. "Don't be so frivolous early in the morning!"
"Who said it was early?" He opened the window and let her take a look at the sky outside.
She blinked and was speechless.
He smiled and presented the food he bought. She was still asleep just now, and he saw someone selling lotus root balls by the window. He thought of letting her try something new, so he went downstairs and bought some.
She woke up as soon as she entered the door.
"Be careful of the burn."
She picked up a golden fried lotus root ball and took a bite. The crispy skin and soft lotus root pulp inside melted on her tongue. The fragrance was overflowing. It was a fresh and delicious taste that she had never tasted before.
"Is it delicious?" he asked with a smile.
She nodded repeatedly. "You try one too."
She picked one up and fed it to him. At first he was too scared to eat it, but when he saw her begging face, he still opened his mouth obediently.
He has a big mouth, and every mouth is like a mouth.
She calculated happily. "There are six more, three for each of us."
He ruffled her hair. "The rest is for you. I went to feed the horses early in the morning and ate two steamed buns first. Get dressed later and I'll take you downstairs for a walk."
After a while, the two of them left the inn together. Puning looked back and forth all the way. To her, the scenes common to ordinary people were all surprises that she, as a princess, could not see. No wonder she was so concerned.
The purpose of taking her on the trip was not only to satisfy her curiosity, but also to help her buy some less eye-catching clothes.
She went to the palaceThe wedding dresses brought out here are not only made of fine materials, but also the embroidery is delicate. These clothes are fine for walking around town, but once you leave the border, they feel awkward.
In Cloth Village, Yu Jiyou and others chose a few double-breasted robes, and bought an extra large cloak decorated with ermine fur - prepared in case they slept in the wild forest. They also bought all the bacon and crispy baked noodles. Returning to the inn, they paid the rent and rode on the road.
It would take at least ten days to get from Xiangzhou to the desert. The two of them would occasionally stay at an inn, and occasionally sleep in the wild forest with their cloaks rolled up. If you have accommodation in a town, you will have better food, but if you don't, Yu Jiyou can still rely on the crossbow he bought to shoot some birds and beasts for cooking - in short, he will have enough food and clothing.
